div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
检查 scene_type 是否属于适用域?
(仅限: 买家评论 / 售后反馈 / 导购短句)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
拒绝调用模型
返回 scene_not_applicable=True

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 按标点与连词(和/以及/顺便/还要)切分为独立子句列表

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
PyTorch 批量推理:
1. 10类实验标签 Softmax 概率
2. 正负向情感 Softmax 概率

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
逐子句检查最高类别概率
max_prob >= 0.65 ?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
标记 predicted_label = 'ABSTAIN' (低置信拒识)
不生成任何类目过滤条件

+ catalog_category_hint='TRAVEL_HOTEL'

检查场景是否为售后反馈
且 sentiment=='NEGATIVE' & score>=0.85?

设置 priority_boost = True
(仅作售后工单高优排序辅助信号, 不直接触发退款)
